source_title: Score Freely with Pydantic Logfire

feature: sandbox isolation and next bounty round

source_title: GHSA-h4xc-3qfq-jf93: web chat endpoint permits cross-site agent execution
claim_summary: Published high-severity advisory for local web chat endpoint allowing website-originated agent runs and tools
limitation: Affected: >=1.34.0 to <1.107.4 on v1; >=2.0.0b1 to <2.28.0 on v2. Local chat content-type check lacking; do not assume localhost prevents cross-site web requests.

source_title: StackOne is now a Pydantic AI capability
claim_summary: Vendor announces connector gateway capability for linked SaaS accounts
limitation: Provider consent and per-action privileges must be scoped; no independent task testing

source_title: GHSA-q2xc-rrxj-58x9 DNS rebinding
claim_summary: Published advisory: web chat local server does not validate Host header making DNS rebinding possible
limitation: Affected >=1.34.0 to <1.107.5 on v1 and >=2.0.0b1 to <2.30.0 on v2; validate Host and explicitly allowed hostnames when using UI through tunnels.

source_title: The 7 best LLM evaluation tools in 2026
claim_summary: Company published vendor-comparative evaluation and pricing discussion; page updated Sep 12
limitation: Not independent benchmarking; prices and plan terms are contextual assumptions

source_title: You.com is now a Pydantic AI capability
claim_summary: Vendor publishes YouSearch and YouResearch capabilities backed by third-party APIs
limitation: External terms permissions and hallucination risks remain; domain filters are not a security boundary

source_title: Durable execution in Pydantic AI agents with AWS Lambda Durability
claim_summary: Vendor documents AWSLambdaDurability checkpoints requiring durable handler and Python 3.11 or later
limitation: Requires AWS durable APIs and IAM; attaching capability alone does not checkpoint

source_title: Generate images with Pydantic AI
claim_summary: Vendor announces ImageGenerator direct API for dedicated providers and image capability for agents
limitation: Provider model availability and rights/cost scope require exact pinned evidence

source_title: GHSA-vmxc-h2x2-jmf3 IPv6 zone SSRF
claim_summary: Published SSRF cloud-metadata blocklist bypass via IPv6 zone identifiers
limitation: Affected starting at 1.56.0 on v1 and >=2.0.0b1 on v2 until patch; exploit only when local URL access explicitly allowed in FileUrl/web_fetch; this is not general sandbox compromise.

source_title: GHSA-4x9p-g9wm-8q7f telemetry redaction gap
claim_summary: Published issue: include_content=False fails to redact exceptions statuses instructions and output template
limitation: Affected v1 starting at 0.3.4 and v2 >=2.0.0b1 until patch; disabling include_content did not redact exceptions statuses instructions or output templates. Beware retention/revocation.

source_title: High-volume AI scoring with Jev and Pydantic Evals
claim_summary: Vendor documents synthetic Jev evaluation workflow and cost assumptions
limitation: Eight examples vendor-authored and pricing simulation is not external validity

source_title: Jev is now available in Pydantic AI Gateway
claim_summary: Vendor describes native TypeSafe Jev gateway route with BYOK and no streaming or chat playground
limitation: No independent installation; service terms and fees separate

source_title: Debug production from Cursor with Logfire MCP
claim_summary: Vendor demonstrates exposing OpenTelemetry traces logs and metrics to MCP clients inside editor
limitation: Development IDE should not gain production trace access without consent and least privilege

source_title: GHSA-6fqq-452j-qhrp stream slot retention
claim_summary: Published high severity concurrency slot retention after model streams complete or interrupt
availability: patched in pydantic-ai/pydantic-ai-slim 2.53.0; v1 not affected
limitation: Affected only v2 >=2.10.0 to <2.53.0 with ConcurrencyLimitedModel or limit_model_concurrency streaming; agent-level max_concurrency and nonstreaming not affected.

source_title: Would you deploy an agent you don't control?
claim_summary: Vendor argues developers should retain explicit control over agent tools and dependencies
limitation: Company opinion contrasts competing framework; not independent benchmark
